keyEvents.text: Di'Shon Bernard (Sheffield Wednesday) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Jamal Lowe (Sheffield Wednesday).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay in match because of an injury Ashley Maynard-Brewer (Sheffield Wednesday).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Sheffield Wednesday. Connal Trueman replaces Ashley Maynard-Brewer because of an injury.
Yan Valery (Sheffield Wednesday) is shown the yellow card.
Second Half begins Oldham Athletic 0, Sheffield Wednesday 0.
